label: Bible Study
prompt: What is man, that thou art _____ of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verse: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
note: David under the night sky, amazed God notices us at all — Hebrews 2 quotes this verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My beloved is _____, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
verse: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
note: My beloved is mine, and I am his — the Song's refrain of belonging, echoed again in 6:3.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of _____ and honey in the carcase of the lion.
verse: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
note: Back at the lion's carcass, Samson found a swarm of bees and honey — the secret behind his famous riddle.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: _____ ye, and believe the gospel.
verse: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
note: Jesus' first proclamation in Mark, in one breath: the time's up, the kingdom's here — turn around and believe.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a _____ of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verse: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
note: 'Shew' is the KJV's spelling of show: Christ made a public spectacle of the powers he disarmed at the cross.
